title: fix(app-shell): phone drawer closes on navigation; 44 px top-bar targets below md
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbK4VDoUnQep5cHGSLk5j5J5)_

Fixes #29075

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度（375/390 px）下，侧边抽屉里点任一入口后抽屉会自动关上；顶栏的按钮（侧栏开关、应用图标、搜索、收件箱、头像等）和它们打开的菜单行在 768 px 以下都放大到 44 px 触控尺寸。为放得下，640 px 以下应用内顶栏不再画产品图标和 Studio 按钮，两者仍在应用切换菜单里（「Back to home」和 Studio 一行），抽屉的「All apps」也能回首页。
- **为什么改**：Mobile 2.0 用 WebView 承载 Console（#29040），手机用户只有响应式布局。实测：点抽屉入口后新页面被仍然打开的抽屉盖住，要再点一次；顶栏控件只有 28–34 px，菜单行 32/38 px，低于 44 px。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的 7 个布局文件的 `max-md:` / `max-sm:` 类名，加一个按路由关闭手机抽屉的 effect；768 px 以上外观与行为不变（1280 px 实测尺寸与 main 相同）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 新增的 `routeKey` effect；② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` 产品图标与 Studio 按钮的 `max-sm:hidden`；③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx` 的触发器与菜单行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm`，浏览器 375 px 打开 Accounts：顶栏是 ☰ · 应用图标 · 标题 · 搜索 · 铃铛 · 头像；点 ☰ 再点 Contacts，抽屉自动关上，直接看到联系人列表。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Navigation flow of the Console at phone width, audited at 375×812 and 390×844 on `examples/app-crm` and `examples/app-showcase` (card #29075; parent audit #29040).

- **The phone drawer closes on navigation** (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx`). Below 768 px the sidebar is a drawer over the page. A tapped entry opened its page under a drawer that stayed open, so every navigation cost a second tap. The sidebar now closes the drawer when the route (pathname and search) changes. It is keyed on the route, not on one row's handler, so navigation, favorite and recent rows and any other control that changes the route all close it. Wider windows are unchanged: the effect acts only while the sidebar is in its mobile form.
- **44 px controls below `md`.** `max-md:size-11` on the sidebar trigger (class passed by `AppHeader`), the product mark, search, the Studio buttons, the AI button and the account avatar (`AppHeader.tsx`), the inbox bell (`InboxPopover.tsx`, the trigger's class only), the theme and language buttons (`ModeToggle.tsx`, `LocaleSwitcher.tsx`) and the page header's Refresh (`PageHeader.tsx`). The app pill gets `max-md:min-h-11 max-md:min-w-11` (`AppSwitcher.tsx`).
- **44 px menu rows below `md`.** The app switcher, account, theme and language menus carry `max-md:[&_[role=menuitem]]:min-h-11` on their content, so every row they hold, including rows drawn from metadata (hidden apps in the account menu), is 44 px tall. The dropdown primitive (`ui/dropdown-menu.tsx`) is not edited.
- **Room in a 375 px bar.** Seven 44 px controls left about 30 px for the page title. Below 640 px an app's bar therefore draws neither the product mark (and its `/` rule) nor the Studio button. Both stay one tap away: the app switcher's menu has "Back to home" and the Studio row (the bar hands it the same target), and the drawer's "All apps" goes home. Home and the other platform surfaces keep the product mark, at 44 px; the empty trigger slot there is not drawn below 640 px. Where a host hides the switcher for a single app, Studio is not offered on a phone bar; Studio is a desktop authoring surface.
- No prop, export, i18n key or metadata changes.

## Run record

Production Console build served at `/_console` by `objectstack dev --fresh` for "before" (main 6b3ba82c); the Vite Console on the branch source against the same backends for "after". Chromium with `isMobile` and touch, DPR 2. `touch-44` lists every visible interactive element under 44 px on either side in the named scope. The keyboard check focuses the search field and shrinks the viewport by 40 % (Android `adjustResize`); iOS `visualViewport` is not simulated.

Other checks of the card:

- **No horizontal page scroll:** pass in every state measured (home, landing, switcher open, drawer open, group toggled, drawer scrolled, after navigation, search, keyboard, account menu, list, record), both examples, both widths.
- **Dialogs and drawers fit the viewport:** pass (drawer 288 px wide, switcher, palette and account menu inside the viewport).
- **Virtual keyboard:** pass (search field 69 to 127 px from the top with the keyboard up).
- **Long lists at CPU 4×** (production build; click to the first painted frame after the drawer mounts): drawer open on app-crm 107 to 253 ms, on app-showcase (46 entries) 294 to 576 ms; nav-group toggle 173 to 252 ms; 20 frames of drawer scroll 316 to 524 ms. Drawer open on the larger app is over a 200 ms interaction budget and is not changed here: #29141.
- **Back:** Back after a drawer navigation returns to the previous page (pass). Back with the drawer open leaves the page instead of closing the drawer: #29131. On the record page the phone ‹ is a link, so Back after ‹ reopens the record; routed to the Record flow with seat 4.

Screenshots before and after each fix are in the project folder `issue-29075/` (`before/`, `after/`), with the run record `run-record-before.md` and the script `audit.cjs`.

## Tests

- New `UnifiedSidebar.phoneDrawerCloses-29075.test.tsx` (4 tests, real `SidebarProvider` and `@object-ui/layout`): a tapped drawer entry closes the drawer; a navigation from outside the drawer closes it too; the same route leaves it open; CONTROL, a wide window's sidebar is unchanged by a route change.
- New `AppHeader.phoneTargets-29075.test.tsx` (8 tests, harness of `AppHeader.sidebarTrigger-12429.test.tsx`): the 44 px classes on the bar's controls in an app and on Home; the product mark, its rule and the Studio buttons hidden below `sm` inside an app only; CONTROL, the trigger, search and avatar are never hidden; the menus' row class and the controls drawn by `AppSwitcher`, `ModeToggle`, `LocaleSwitcher`, `InboxPopover` and `PageHeader`, read from their source.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD byte-identical by blob hash): the drawer close made a no-op (`if (isMobile && Date.now() < 0) setOpenMobile(false);`) reds 2 of 4 in the drawer test, the two navigation cases.

Run from `ui/` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, head 05647568:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` on the two new files: exit 0, 2 files, 12 tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the 79 existing `layout/__tests__` files for `AppHeader`, `AppSwitcher`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `PageHeader`, `ConsolePageHeader`, `InboxPopover` and `LocaleSwitcher` (including `AppHeader.homeMark-12605`, which pins the product mark's classes): exit 0, 79 files, 512 tests (run at 7a92e5de; 05647568 changes only the two new test files).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the ten changed files: no errors; the warnings are the files' existing `any` and hook warnings, none on a changed line.

## Acceptance notes

- Claim 6571165367, amendments 6571821121 and 6572041449 (the file surface: the seven layout files, two tests, the root changeset).
- Not fixed here: Back with the drawer open, #29131; drawer open over budget at CPU 4×, #29141; the record page ‹ and Next and the palette Close (`dialog.tsx`), seat 4's Record and Overlay cards; the list toolbar, #29074; the notification switches, #29076; the home page body's small links, a card the seat is filing.
- `LocalizedSidebarTrigger.tsx` was in the amended surface and needed no edit: `AppHeader` passes the class.
- The derived gate `check-sdui-manifest` is green: no component config changed.
